features: Room for it all: Up to 4TB of space for photos, videos and everything worth keeping.
No fuss. Just storage: Easy everyday storage that’s simple to set up and use, so you can start backing up important files right away.
For the “uh, oh” moments: Includes Rescue Data Recovery Services for added protection.
Made to move: Portable, lightweight and compact enough for home, school, work, travel, and everything in between.
Very compatible: Works with most Windows and macOS systems for use across devices.
description: Carry your digital world in your pocket with the Expansion portable 2.5-inch external hard drive. Sleek and lightweight, it delivers fast, flexible and secure storage for photos, media and everyday files. Easy to use and ready when you are, it features plug-and-play usability, universal connectivity and Rescue Data Recovery Services. Keep everything that matters close, wherever you go.
